title: Cartesian Rees exchange for an arbitrary Cartesian presentation of smooth section pairs
statement: Let $S,S'$ be Noetherian schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and let $g:V\to S$ be smooth, separated, quasi-compact of pure relative dimension $d\geq0$ [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. Let $g':V'\to S'$ be a morphism and let $s:S\to V$, $s':S'\to V'$ be closed immersions [def-weil-closed-immersion] with $g s=1_S$ and $g's'=1_{S'}$. Suppose $(q,g',g,b)$ is a Cartesian square [def-pc-fibre-product], where $q:V'\to V$ and $b:S'\to S$, and $q s'=s b$. For the ideals $I,I'$ of the section images [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf], form the actual extended-Rees deformations $D_sV=\operatorname{Spec}_V\mathcal O_V[t,I/t]$ and $D_{s'}V'=\operatorname{Spec}_{V'}\mathcal O_{V'}[t,I'/t]$ [def-pur-rees-cone-normalization]. The coefficientwise Rees map induced by $q$ and $b$ gives a Cartesian square $D_{s'}V'\to D_sV$ over $\mathbf A^1_{S'}\to\mathbf A^1_S$, where the lower arrow is induced by $b$ and fixes $t$. No flatness of $b$ is assumed.

proof.text: Identify V' with the canonical pullback V×_S S' using the universal property. The sections agree under this isomorphism by equality of their two projections; their ideal sheaves therefore agree after comap.

On each affine neighbourhood in the canonical pullback use the centred-coordinate extended-Rees pushout. Pull the affine neighbourhood back along the pair isomorphism; its ring map is an isomorphism and carries the section ideal onto the new section ideal. The induced extended-Rees map is an isomorphism. Paste this isomorphism pushout with the canonical base-change pushout.

Composition of coefficient maps identifies the pasted map with the direct Rees map for q. The affine pullback criterion then glues the Cartesian deformation square. The coordinate t is fixed, so the line map is AffineSpace.map b.

theorem pairMap_isPullback
    {V S V' S' : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian S] [IsNoetherian S']
    (d : ℕ) (g : V ⟶ S) (g' : V' ⟶ S')
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d g] [IsSeparated g] [QuasiCompact g]
    (s : S ⟶ V) (s' : S' ⟶ V') [IsClosedImmersion s] [IsClosedImmersion s']
    (hs : s ≫ g = 𝟙 S) (hs' : s' ≫ g' = 𝟙 S')
    (b : S' ⟶ S) (q : V' ⟶ V) (cart : IsPullback q g' g b)
    (hsec : s' ≫ q = b ≫ s) :
    IsPullback (pairMap s s' q b hsec) (Scheme.Hom.deformationSpaceProj g' s')
      (Scheme.Hom.deformationSpaceProj g s) (AffineSpace.map (ULift.{u} (Fin 1)) b)
